bias.en: Bearish · lost $62, testing the $58.4 April low
bias.zh: 看空 · 失守 $62，测试 4月 $58.4 低点

read.en: Intel fell 8.8% on Nov 2 to $59.97, trading between $59.40 and $65.72 on twice average volume, down 33.7% in five sessions. It is below the falling 5-day ($81.4), 10-day ($85.5), 30-day ($102.5) and 100-day ($104.3) averages and the rising 200-day ($86.9). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 5 and below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($95.03), and RSI is 23, oversold.
read.zh: 英特尔 11月2日下跌 8.8%，收于 $59.97，盘中区间 $59.40–65.72，成交量约为均量的 2 倍，五个交易日累计下跌 33.7%。股价位于下行的 5 日（$81.4）、10 日（$85.5）、30 日（$102.5）和 100 日均线（$104.3）以及上行的 200 日均线（$86.9）下方。MACD 自 10月5日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图放大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$95.03），RSI 为 23，处于超卖。

read.en: The drop broke the $63.2–65.0 and $62.1–62.2 supports, now resistance. Resistance is $60.75–62.2 (Apr 10, 13 and 14 lows), then $63.2–65.7 (Oct 30 low, Apr 20–22 lows, Nov 2 high) and $68.3–68.8 (Apr 23 and Oct 30 highs). Support is $58.4–59.4 (Apr 9 low, Nov 2 low), then $54.8 (Apr 8 low) and $49.9–50. A close above $62.2 would target $65; below $58.4, $54.8.

r.en: Apr 10 low $60.75; Apr 13 and Apr 14 lows ($62.1–62.2), lost
Oct 30 low $63.2, lost; Apr 20 and Apr 22 lows ($64.5–65.0); Nov 2 high $65.7
